slides.title: Three Key Judgments
slides.subtitle: What Thomas should take away from this discussion about China's AI reality

judgments_3.title: China is developing its own path
judgments_3.main: China is not simply following a global AI playbook. It is developing its own path of adoption.
judgments_3.support: The environment is shaped by open models, rapid experimentation, manufacturing depth, and business integration.

judgments_3.title: Distinctive combination of advantages
judgments_3.main: China's distinctive feature is the combination of speed, scale, market integration, and business experimentation.
judgments_3.support: What matters is not only model capability, but the shorter loop from technology to real business use.

judgments_3.title: AI is moving beyond productivity tools
judgments_3.main: AI is moving from productivity tools into workflows, decisions, software development, and organizational design.
judgments_3.support: The real management question is no longer whether AI can help. It is what should change inside the enterprise.

slides.callout: The next question is not whether AI will change the business. It is how deliberately, measurably, and how quickly we choose to shape that change.

footer.left: Executive Discussion Deck | China AI Environment and Business Reinvention

slides.speaker_notes: 3 大关键判断。1）中国走自己的路径（开源+快速迭代+制造深度+业务整合）。2）独特优势是速度+规模+整合+实验组合。3）AI 从工具走向工作流/决策/软件开发/组织设计。底部 3 阶段进阶：Productivity → Workflow → Reinvention。
